'''Karis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] and a member of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Go, and lead us to victory.|Karis, to Ventress, right before her death|<ref name="Massacre" />}}
[[File:VentressStrikeTeam-FFp48.png|thumb|left|220px|Karis, alongside Naa'leth and Ventress attempted to assassinate Dooku.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Karis was recognized by her master [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] as one of the greatest warriors of her [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] clan, alongside fellow sister [[Naa'leth/Legends|Naa'leth]].<ref name="Nightsisters">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref> When [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] returned home to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], Karis was ordered to accompany her and Naa'leth to [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] in an attempt to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] in retribution for his betrayal of Ventress, though they were defeated. Soon after the failed attack on Count Dooku, the Count sent [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to the planet of Dathomir and launched an attack. A vulture droid fired a missile that lead a chain reaction of falling statues from the Temple of the Nightsisters.

Karis was the first person to suffer a casualty because that was the ambush attack that started the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|Battle of Dathomir]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] when a statue (that fell when shot by a [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|droid bomber]]) crushed her. Asajj Ventress managed to pull her out, but Karis said her last few words about leading the Nightsisters to victory, and died.<ref name="Massacre" /> [[File:KarisDead-Massacre.png|thumb|right|300px|Karis dies in Ventress' arms]]

==Powers and abilities==
Karis was hard to detect due to the spells cast upon her by Mother Talzin. Her weapons included a captured [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and a [[Nightsister dagger]]. She could move silently and had [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-enhanced reflexes.<sup>[3]</sup>

In combat, Karis was known to use the "raging rancor" battle charge.<ref name="TCW H2H" />

==Behind the scenes==
Karis is portrayed by actress [[Catherine Taber]].
